links.outcome: Documentation burden (NASA-TLX, TrendBurden) and time on notes after ambient scribe pilot
links.effect: NASA-TLX improved from 56.3 to 43.3 (p<0.001) and TrendBurden items improved. Time on notes per note showed no significant change (median +0.4 minutes, p=0.568).
links.quote: No significant difference in time spent on notes activity per note written was observed, with a median increase of 0.4 minutes (p = 0.568).

screen.reason: Prospective observational pilot study evaluating the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe among resident trainees, assessing usability, cognitive load, and documentation burden.
